note: Declarative retention registry. db_retention.py enforces DELETE and ARCHIVE_THEN_DELETE rows (archive = jsonl.gz under persistent-state/archive/db_retention/<table>/ BEFORE the delete; the delete runs only if the archived row count equals the matching count). KEEP_FOREVER rows are never deleted; archive=true on them means a yearly archive copy. check_retention_policy.py fails CI when a row is malformed or a KEEP_FOREVER row lacks a reason; report_db_hygiene.py (nightly) fails the lane and raises an incident when a large or growing table has no row here, when duplicate indexes reappear, or when the database exceeds size_budget_gb. Classes: DELETE, ARCHIVE_THEN_DELETE, KEEP_FOREVER, EXTERNAL_POLICY (enforced by a named job elsewhere; hygiene still watches its window when window_days is set). 2026-10-08: six rows added for the tables the first nightly hygiene report flagged UNCOVERED_TABLE (operator-reviewed PR).
